description: This file defines Pydantic models and utility functions for handling notes in a MongoDB-backed application. It includes custom types for ObjectId, models for creating, updating, and outputting notes, as well as functions to convert between MongoDB documents and Pydantic models.

classes.name: PydanticObjectId
classes.description: A custom type extending bson.ObjectId with Pydantic validators for proper validation and serialization.

classes.name: NoteIn
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a note, requiring title and content.

classes.name: NoteUpdate
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating a note, with optional fields.

classes.name: NoteOut
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a note as returned by the API, including metadata like createdAt and updatedAt.

methods.name: __get_validators__(cls)
methods.description: Class method providing validators for Pydantic to validate custom ObjectId type.

methods.name: "PydanticObjectId" validate(cls, v: Any)
methods.description: Class method to validate and convert input to a PydanticObjectId, accepting ObjectId instances or valid ObjectId strings.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] __get_pydantic_json_schema__(cls, schema: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Provides JSON schema for PydanticObjectId for OpenAPI documentation.

methods.name: str _ensure_non_empty(value: str, field_name: str)
methods.description: Utility function ensuring a string is neither None nor whitespace.

methods.name: str validate_title_not_empty(cls, v: str)
methods.description: Validator ensuring the title field of NoteIn is not empty or whitespace.

methods.name: Optional[str] validate_optional_title_not_empty(cls, v: Optional[str])
methods.description: Validator ensuring that if the title in NoteUpdate is provided, it is not empty or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_title_not_empty (in NoteOut)
methods.description: Validator ensuring the title field of NoteOut is not empty or whitespace.

methods.name: NoteOut mongo_doc_to_note_out(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Function converting a MongoDB document into a NoteOut model instance.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] note_in_to_mongo_doc(note: NoteIn)
methods.description: Converts a NoteIn model into a MongoDB document with timestamps.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] apply_note_update(existing_doc: Dict[str, Any], update: NoteUpdate)
methods.description: Applies a NoteUpdate to an existing MongoDB document, updating fields and timestamp.
